atnf.selection: Reviewed or ATNF DIST <= 3.0660139380 kpc (10000 ly), and <= 0.9198041814 kpc when only a dispersion-measure model distance exists; no CAND or INTERIM type; verbatim psrcat.db records and their glitch.db rows

previous.change: Selection widened on 2026-11-05 from 3000 to 10000 light-years, requiring a distance independent of the dispersion-measure model beyond 3000 light-years. All 272 earlier pulsars remain selected. On 2026-11-18 the same package was refrozen after reviewed remnant distances placed PSR J0205+6449 (3C 58, 2 kpc) and PSR J1856+0113 (W44, 3 kpc) inside the radius; all 420 earlier pulsars remain selected.

atnf.landmarkSelection: Reviewed landmark pulsars beyond the radius listed in atnf-landmarks.json, from the same package; added 2026-11-18 with PSR J1748-2446ad.

blackcat.result: The live catalogue page was unreachable on 2026-11-05, so the catalogue paper and newer primary literature were reviewed; GRS 1716-249 was excluded after its distance was revised to 6.9 kpc.
